we have developed tools for the authoring and the delivery of technology enhanced inquiry based lessons that support teachers in collecting and analyzing inquiry learning data, which can be used for reflective lesson planning targeting the development of students' problem solving (PS), a key competence of the scientific literacy.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a set of tools to facilitate the design of inquiry based science lessons, which are aligned with the 5E inquiry based teaching model, the PISA 2015 PSF assessment framework and the Inspiring Science Education (ISE) pedagogical model.

the following questions: (1) What kind of tools can support teachers in collecting inquiry based teaching learning analytics data and (2) How to support teachers with evidence based reflective lesson plan design for facilitating students' problem solving development through inquiry based learning?

the following research questions: (a) Can inquiry learning data from students' problem solving activities be used as evidence for supporting reflective lesson planning? and (b) What are the design requirements for inquiry learning data collection, processing and analysis to facilitate reflective lesson planning?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed tools are expected to support teachers in designing, authoring, delivering, assessing and analyzing inquiry learning activities in a way that can facilitate students' PS competence learning.

these tools support the development of students' PS competence through inquiry based teaching, by providing teachers with a framework for authoring and delivery inquiry based science lessons, while incorporating Pisa PSF compatible assessment at the same time.

the Inspiring Science Education tools are a set of tools for supporting the development and implementation of inquiry based teaching and learning activities that are based on the 5E learning cycle model and are aligned with PISA 2015 PS competence assessment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Inspiring Science Education tools can be used for supporting science education teachers in designing and delivering lessons which follow an adaptation to the 5E inquiry based teaching model, while incorporating problem solving competence assessment activities at each stage of inquiry, thus supporting the collection of students' inquiry learning data.

our tools can support science teachers in authoring inquiry based lesson plans which can be delivered in a technology enhanced way, while collecting and analyzing inquiry learning data to support reflective lesson planning for facilitating the development of the problem solving competence of the students.
the presented set of tools can support science education teachers in designing and implementing technology enhanced lessons based on an adaptation of the widely used 5E model.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of technology can facilitate the design of inquiry based teaching and assessment activities that are compatible with PISA 2013 PSF, while supporting teachers in their reflective lesson planning based on inquiry learning analytics.

the proposed inquiry based teaching and assessment tools can be used by science teachers to support the development of students' PS competence in a systematic manner and to support evidence based reflection for lesson plan authoring and lesson delivery improvement.

by supporting the analysis of inquiry learning analytics data, teachers can reflect on their lesson plans and teaching activities and adapt them accordingly in order to improve students' PS competence performance.
